title: The Lantern Maker's Secret
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文和问题均为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
A. Last winter, I visited a small town in Zhejiang. It was the week before the Spring Festival. While I was walking along the river, I saw an old man making lanterns. His name was Mr. Chen. He was sitting outside his shop, and he was painting a red lantern with a thin brush. When I stopped to watch, he smiled and said, "You are the first visitor today."

B. Mr. Chen told me that he had been making lanterns for forty years. He learned the skill from his father, who learned it from his grandfather. "When I was a boy, every family made their own lanterns," he said. "Now, few people do. But I still make them because I love it." While we were talking, a young woman came to buy a lantern. She said, "My grandmother always bought one from Mr. Chen. Now I buy one for my new home." Mr. Chen looked happy when he heard this.

C. I asked Mr. Chen why lanterns are important. He explained, "Lanterns are symbols of hope and family. During the festival, people hang them to welcome good luck." He also showed me a special lantern which had a picture of a rabbit on it. "This one is for children," he said. "Rabbits are lucky animals in our culture." While I was taking a photo, he gave me a small lantern as a gift. I felt very thankful. That day, I learned that traditions live on when people like Mr. Chen keep them alive.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时间正在发生的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when 或 while 连用：when 后面常接短暂动作，while 后面常接持续动作。定语从句用来修饰名词，who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。例如：the man who was painting；the lantern which had a picture。
grammar.example: While I was walking along the river, I saw an old man making lanterns.

options: While I was reading, the phone rang.
While I read, the phone was ringing.
While I was reading, the phone was ring.
While I reading, the phone rang.
answers: While I was reading, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的持续动作常用过去进行时 was reading，主句用一般过去时 rang 表示短暂动作。
questions.evidence: While I was walking along the river, I saw an old man making lanterns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The woman ______ bought a lantern was very happy.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the woman 指人，定语从句用 who 引导。
questions.evidence: a young woman came to buy a lantern

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The lantern ______ had a rabbit picture was for children.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the lantern 指物，定语从句用 which 引导。
questions.evidence: a special lantern which had a picture of a rabbit on it

options: When I was walking home, I met an old friend.
When I walked home, I was meeting an old friend.
When I was walking home, I was meet an old friend.
When I walking home, I met an old friend.
answers: When I was walking home, I met an old friend.
questions.explanation: when 从句常用过去进行时表示背景动作，主句用一般过去时表示突然发生的动作。
questions.evidence: When I stopped to watch, he smiled and said, "You are the first visitor today."
